source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: At the beginning of your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), you may pick a friendly **NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER** other than Trazyn who is on the battlefield. **EPIC HERO** and **SKORPEKH LORD** models are excluded. Destroy the chosen model without resolving rules that trigger on its destruction. Put Trazyn in that position with full wounds. He inherits command of any unit the casualty led.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

effect.ifTargetWasLeading: Trazyn joins its unit as Leader
